capabilities: copy or move files and folders to configured local vaults
review direct markdown links before transfer
rewrite wiki and markdown links after transfer
resolve conflicts with skip, auto-rename, or overwrite
tag transferred notes via YAML frontmatter
extras: Desktop only; the plugin accesses files outside the active vault and states it uses no network, no account, and no payment.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to transfer files between vaults, so moving notes with their folder structure, attachments, and intact links requires manual copying and relinking.

relations.evidence: Optional Notebook Navigator context menu integration when that plugin exposes its menu API.

summary: Desktop plugin that copies or moves notes, folders, and linked attachments between local Obsidian vaults, rewriting links and tagging transferred files.
